name: kaava-mcp

tools.name: kaava_create_system
tools.description: Generate a complete design system from a short brief and save it as kaava.json in the project root. Only brandColor is required; style picks a hand-authored character for the rest (read kaava://styles for what each one is). Returns a summary and a contrast report. Follow with kaava_emit to write tokens for the project stack.

name.description: Name of the design system or product.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the product is and who it is for.

brandColor.description: Primary brand color in any CSS syntax: "#4f46e5", "rgb(79 70 229)", "oklch(0.55 0.2 270)", "rebeccapurple".

accent.description: Secondary accent color (CSS color). Omit to derive one from the brand hue according to the style.

style.description: A hand-authored style that decides the character of the system: ramp shape, typography, spacing rhythm, corners, elevation, motion. The fields below override single aspects of it; leave them out to keep the style as designed.

neutralTint.description: How much of the brand hue tints the greys. 0 = pure grey, 1 = clearly tinted.

density.description: Control sizes and spacing rhythm. Default: the density the style was designed for.

radius.description: Replace the style's corner rounding with a generic scale. "full" gives pill-shaped controls.

typeScale.description: Replace the style's type sizes with a modular scale of this ratio. 1.125 = tight/dense UI, 1.2 = balanced, 1.333 = expressive/editorial.

fonts.description: Font families. A single name ("Inter") gets a system fallback stack appended; a comma-separated value is used as the full stack. `display` is for headings and defaults to `sans`.

shadows.description: Replace the style's shadows with a generic recipe, or "none" for a flat system.

darkMode.description: Generate a dark theme. Default true.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing kaava.json. Without this, an existing system is left untouched.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the first workspace root the client exposes, else the server working directory.

dryRun.description: Return the content that would be written instead of writing files.

tools.name: kaava_update_system
tools.description: Change the existing design system: patch brief fields (everything is re-derived) and/or override individual tokens. Files written earlier by kaava_emit are regenerated. Overrides are keyed by token path, e.g. {"radius.control": "{radius.full}", "dark:color.primary": "#8b9cff", "font.size.base": "1.0625rem"}; prefix semantic colors with "light:" or "dark:" to target one theme.

brief.description: Brief fields to change. Omitted fields keep their current value.

name.description: Name of the design system or product.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the product is and who it is for.

brandColor.description: Primary brand color in any CSS syntax: "#4f46e5", "rgb(79 70 229)", "oklch(0.55 0.2 270)", "rebeccapurple".

accent.description: Secondary accent color (CSS color). Omit to derive one from the brand hue according to the style.

style.description: A hand-authored style that decides the character of the system: ramp shape, typography, spacing rhythm, corners, elevation, motion. The fields below override single aspects of it; leave them out to keep the style as designed.

neutralTint.description: How much of the brand hue tints the greys. 0 = pure grey, 1 = clearly tinted.

density.description: Control sizes and spacing rhythm. Default: the density the style was designed for.

radius.description: Replace the style's corner rounding with a generic scale. "full" gives pill-shaped controls.

typeScale.description: Replace the style's type sizes with a modular scale of this ratio. 1.125 = tight/dense UI, 1.2 = balanced, 1.333 = expressive/editorial.

fonts.description: Font families. A single name ("Inter") gets a system fallback stack appended; a comma-separated value is used as the full stack. `display` is for headings and defaults to `sans`.

shadows.description: Replace the style's shadows with a generic recipe, or "none" for a flat system.

darkMode.description: Generate a dark theme. Default true.

overrides.description: Token overrides to add or replace: path -> CSS value or "{other.token}".

removeOverrides.description: Override keys to remove, restoring the derived value.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the first workspace root the client exposes, else the server working directory.

dryRun.description: Return the content that would be written instead of writing files.

tools.name: kaava_get_tokens
tools.description: Look up tokens from the current design system. Without a path, returns the list of token groups. With a path prefix ("color", "color.primary", "palette.neutral", "font.size", "space", "radius", "shadow"), returns each token with its CSS variable and value. Semantic colors live under "color"; raw ramps under "palette".

path.description: Token path or prefix, e.g. "color" or "font.size.lg".

mode.description: Show only this theme for semantic colors. Default: both.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the first workspace root the client exposes, else the server working directory.

tools.name: kaava_emit
tools.description: Write the design system out for the project stack. Targets: "css" (custom properties, works with any framework), "tailwind" (Tailwind v4 @theme), "scss", "ts" (typed token object for React/Vue/Svelte/React Native), "dtcg" (W3C design tokens JSON for Figma/Style Dictionary), "design-md" (DESIGN.md in the open DESIGN.md format: tokens as YAML front matter plus usage rules, for agents and people), "preview" (self-contained preview.html showing the system in use, for the user to open in a browser). The choice is remembered, so later kaava_update_system calls regenerate the same files.

outDir.description: Directory relative to the project root. Default: the directory used last time, else "kaava".

overwrite.description: Replace existing files in outDir that Kaava did not generate. Without this, such files are left untouched and the call fails.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the first workspace root the client exposes, else the server working directory.

dryRun.description: Return the content that would be written instead of writing files.

tools.name: kaava_audit
tools.description: Accessibility audit of the current design system against WCAG 2.2 AA, in light and dark. Checks every promised foreground/background pairing (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI, with APCA Lc for reference), whether solid fills have a visible boundary, whether status colors stay distinguishable with color-vision deficiencies (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia), control target sizes and minimum text size. Run after overriding colors or sizes. It audits the tokens, not rendered pages.

failuresOnly.description: List only failures and warnings. Default false.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the first workspace root the client exposes, else the server working directory.

tools.name: kaava_check_contrast
tools.description: Check one foreground/background pair against WCAG 2.2 and report the APCA Lc value. Each color is a CSS color ("#767676", "rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6)") or a token of the current design system ("color.fg-muted", "--color-primary", "palette.neutral.400"). When the pair fails, returns the nearest passing color of the same hue and the system text colors that do pass on that background. Use it before introducing a pairing the system does not already promise. Works without a kaava.json when both colors are CSS colors.

foreground.description: Text, icon or border color: a CSS color or a token.

background.description: The color behind it: a CSS color or a token.

use.description: What the foreground is: "text" (default), "large-text" (24px, or 18.66px bold, and up), or "ui" (icons, borders, focus rings).

level.description: Conformance level to test against. Default AA.

mode.description: Theme used to resolve semantic color tokens. Default light.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the first workspace root the client exposes, else the server working directory.

instructions:
Kaava generates and maintains a project's design system.

You supply the brand color and pick a style; Kaava computes the full token set deterministically: OKLCH color ramps, semantic light/dark roles that are contrast-checked, type scale, spacing, radii, shadows, motion.

Typical flow:
1. kaava_create_system with a brief -> writes kaava.json (the source of truth) in the project root.
2. kaava_emit -> writes tokens for the project's stack (css, tailwind, scss, ts, dtcg) and DESIGN.md with usage rules.
3. Read DESIGN.md (or kaava_get_tokens) before writing UI, and use tokens instead of hard-coded values.
4. kaava_update_system to adjust the brief or override single tokens; previously emitted files are regenerated.
5. kaava_audit after color or size changes, and kaava_check_contrast before using any color pairing the system does not already promise.

Never edit kaava.json or emitted files by hand; they are regenerated.
